build_laplacian_matrix: build a python module to compute the standard laplacian matrix from vertex and edge tensors
build_cotangent_laplacian: build a python module to compute the cotangent weighted laplacian matrix from mesh vertices and faces
build_norm_laplacian: build a python module to compute the norm laplacian matrix weighted by inverse edge distances
test_laplacian: test the laplacian function by passing vertex and edge tensors and verifying the sparse output shape
review_cot_laplacian: review the cot_laplacian function to understand how cotangent weights and inverse face areas are computed
